Package com.stockroom

package com.stockroom
Root package of Stockroom, a Swing-based inventory management system that records stock items in a ledger, derives their stock status and persists them to CSV.
Since:
1.0
Version:
1.0
Author:
Arsal Saeed, Laiba Rehman
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.stockroom.exception
    Checked exception hierarchy used to report invalid input, missing items and duplicate names.
    com.stockroom.model
    Domain model of the inventory: stock items and their derived stock status.
    com.stockroom.persistence
    Persistence layer that saves and loads the inventory, backed by a CSV file.
    com.stockroom.service
    Business logic layer: input validation and the inventory manager that adds, updates, deletes and queries items.
    com.stockroom.ui
    Swing user interface: the application entry point, the main window and the ledger table model.
